scenes.vo: Part two. Seat fourteen B. A row that only exists after midnight. And something tapping on my window.
scenes.cap: Part 2. Seat 14B. Row 14. Something tapping on my window.

scenes.vo: I didn't look. I stared at my ticket. Tap. Tap. Then a voice outside said, in my own voice, let me in. That's my seat.
scenes.cap: A voice outside, in MY voice: "Let me in. That's my seat."

scenes.vo: The man beside me whispered. Every year, one passenger in row fourteen looks outside. And they swap places with whatever is out there.
scenes.cap: "Every year, one passenger looks. And they swap places."

scenes.vo: I checked the three tickets again. One year ago. Two years ago. Three years ago. One for every year.
scenes.cap: Their tickets: 1 year ago. 2 years ago. 3 years ago.

scenes.vo: So I tore my ticket in half. The tapping stopped. The lights flickered. And row fourteen was gone. I was sitting in seat thirteen D.
scenes.cap: I tore my ticket. The tapping stopped. Row 14 was gone.

scenes.vo: At my stop, the conductor handed me a new ticket. Seat fourteen B. Dated one year from today. See you next year?
scenes.cap: A new ticket. Seat 14B. Dated one year from today.
